title: Halloween — Don't Look at the Glass (Optional Animation)

source_video.audio: AAC, stereo, 48 kHz; omitted from the wallpaper export
source_video.distribution: Local input retained unchanged; not included in the published asset set.
source_video.provenance: Animation supplied by the repository owner for scene 14. The generation tool, model version, prompt and settings were not specified for this file and are not inferred.

content: A separate animation of scene 14: the figure behind wet glass curls and extends its fingers, shifts its hand and changes facial expression. Neither corridor video is replaced or concatenated.
loop: Playback repeats from the start; this export is not advertised as a seamless loop.
producer: Animation supplied by the repository owner; generator not specified for this file. FFmpeg used only for the silent VP9 export.
ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version n9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
production_command_note: The output argument is normalized to the published path; encoding ran in a temporary directory and the resulting file was copied unchanged.
changes: Encoded the supplied H.264 video as VP9 without resizing, cropping, retiming, interpolation, added transitions or upscaling. Omitted audio, attached cover art and source container metadata. The source MP4, both prior optional videos, fourteen still wallpapers and previews remain unchanged.

activation: Additional optional data asset outside backgrounds/. Not installed or enabled by a standard theme installation. Requires an Omarchy build with native OWE video wallpaper support and explicit installation and selection.
